description: CityGML 2.0 + Energy ADE 3.0 (beta 8) GML file creator is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Daan Schlosser (Delft University of Technology). A Python toolkit that generates CityGML 2.0 files extended with Energy ADE 3.0 (beta 8) from flat JSON input plus STEP or CityJSON geometry. It runs a per-building pipeline and a city-scale pipeline that both emit the same wire format, developed for building renovation passports within the RenoDAT project at Delft University of Technology. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is MIT. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
